这时，大长老的直播间里已经有三亿人了，因为刚开播的原因，人数还在不断上涨。甚至就连合欢宗官方这种常年霸榜前五的直播间，都因为大长老的直播而人数暴降。这就是修仙界人气第一的含金量。“直播间的朋友们，大家好，刚刚完成了一场极致的人前显圣哈，现在需要休息一下，今天就解答一下直播间里各位道友的问题吧。”系统消息：玄天宗宗主最严厉的师尊送出超级大灵石一枚！大长老：“好，感谢‘玄天宗宗主最严厉的师尊’送的一点歪瓜裂枣哈，你们手里没多少灵石就不要送了。”“还有，这位道友你最好改个名哈，王玄那小子可是个出了名的小心眼，小心他回头顺着网线真实你！”太上宗主的脑袋突然冒出来。“各位直播间的朋友，给我上上关注哈，就是那个‘玄天宗宗主最严厉的师尊’，回头从关注的人里抽五个人，送玄天宗绝密功法玄天功！”“这玄天功可是玄天宗的绝密功法，只有玄天宗的弟子才能学习，若非玄天宗弟子，学一个杀一个。”“不过大家若是我的粉丝，今天给大家送福利，我这个玄天宗太上长老就为大家破一次例，大家赶紧点点关注哈，过了这个直播间，可就要等下次我直播了。”大长老无语的看了太上宗主一眼，“师叔，这个账号是你的啊！”“没错，大号因为分享不良内容给封了，我又建了个小号，你说我这个名字起的有毛病吗？”大长老：“这确实没有，不过你能不能不要来蹭热度啊，我这直播给粉丝解答问题呢！”太上宗主：“知道了知道了，我先去抽奖了，大家赶紧给我点点关注哈！”大长老转动了一下手机，看着下方弹幕疯狂滚动。幸亏修仙者目力惊人，不然这么快的弹幕滚动，还真看不清。大长老找了一个自认为非常帅气的角度，用自己锋利的下颌线对着众人说道：“接下来先给各位解答一下大家最关心的问题，本座到底能不能打过玄天宗宗主王玄。”“在此之前，我先给大家科普一下玄天宗宗主王玄的含金量。”“王玄是渡劫大圆满修为，身具雷灵根，攻击力极其强悍，加上年纪轻轻，还远没有到衰老的年纪，曾经渡劫后期时，便以一敌三位渡劫大圆满强者，全身而退惊动整个修仙界，自从其踏入渡劫大圆满后，便再也没有全力出手过，让所有人根本不知道其实力深浅，以至于被很多野榜称之为修仙界第一人。”“不过呢，野榜之所以是野榜，是因为他们什么都不懂。”“而本座多次与王玄交过手，现在便可以很公正的告诉各位，到底谁强谁弱！”大长老轻咳一声，开口说道：“本座跟王玄大概三七开吧！”“本座三分钟，打的王玄叫七声‘救命’！”直播间弹幕直接爆炸！

Chapter 1095 The Great Elder’s Daily Live Broadcast (Page 1)
At this time, there were already 300 million people in the Great Elder's live broadcast room. Because the broadcast had just started, the number of people was still rising. Even the Hehuan Sect's official live broadcast room, which has always been in the top five, has seen a sharp drop in the number of people because of the great elder's live broadcast. This is the gold content of the most popular person in the world of immortality. "Hello, friends in the live broadcast room. I have just completed an ultimate holy show in front of people. Now I need to take a rest. Today I will answer the questions of fellow Taoists in the live broadcast room." System message: The most severe master of the Xuantian Sect has given away a super large spiritual stone! Great Elder: "Okay, thank you for the gift from 'The Stern Master of the Xuantian Sect'. If you don't have many spiritual stones, don't give it away." "Also, you'd better change this fellow Taoist's name. Wang Xuan is a notoriously petty boy. Be careful if he turns around and follows the network cable to identify you!" The Supreme Sect Master's head suddenly popped up. "Friends in the live broadcast room, follow me. I am the 'most severe master of Xuantian Sect'. I will pick five people from the following people and give them to Xuantian Sect's top secret technique, Xuantian Kung!" "This Xuantian Kung is Xuantian Sect's top secret technique. Only Xuantian Sect's disciples Only a disciple can learn. If you are not a disciple of Xuantian Sect, you will learn to kill each other. ""But if you are my fans, I will give you a benefit today. I, the supreme elder of Xuantian Sect, will make an exception for you. Please pay attention to it quickly. After passing this live broadcast room, you will have to wait. I broadcast live." The Great Elder looked at the Supreme Sect Leader speechlessly, "Uncle Master, this account is yours!" "That's right, the big account was blocked for sharing inappropriate content, and I created a small account. Do you think there is something wrong with my name?" No, but can you please stop being a fan? I'm answering questions for fans during the live broadcast!" Taishang Sect Master: "I know, I'm going to draw the lottery first, everyone please pay attention to me!" The elder turned his phone and watched the barrage scrolling wildly below. Fortunately, the immortal cultivator has amazing eyesight, otherwise the barrage would be rolling so fast that he would not be able to see clearly. The great elder found an angle that he thought was very handsome, and said to everyone with his sharp jawline: "Next, let me answer the question that everyone is most concerned about, whether I can defeat Wang Xuan, the leader of the Xuantian Sect." "Before that, let me give you some popular science. The gold content of Wang Xuan, the leader of the Xuantian Sect. "Wang Xuan is a Dzogchen master. He possesses thunder spirit roots and has extremely powerful attack power. In addition, he is young and has not yet reached the age of aging. When he was in the late stage of the Tribulation, he defeated three powerful Dzogchen masters and escaped without a trace, shocking the entire cultivator. Since he entered the Great Perfection of Transcending Tribulation, he has never made a full-strength move, leaving everyone unaware of the depth of his strength. As a result, he is called the number one person in the world of cultivating immortals. "But, the reason why Ye Bang is a wild leader is because they don't understand anything." I have fought against Wang Xuan many times, and now I can tell you fairly who is stronger and who is weaker!" The great elder coughed slightly and said, "I and Wang Xuan are about three to seven!" "I fought Wang Xuan seven times in three minutes," and the barrage exploded in the live broadcast room!
